title: Search for heavy neutral leptons in $W^\pm \to \mu^\pm \mu^\pm$ decays at $\sqrt{s}=13$ TeV with the ATLAS detector
summary: A search for heavy neutral leptons (HNLs) decaying into two same-sign muons is performed using $36.1\ \mathrm{fb}^{-1}$ of $pp$ collision data at $\sqrt{s}=13$ TeV collected by the ATLAS detector. The observed data are consistent with Standard Model background expectations. Upper limits are set on the mixing parameter $|U_{\mu N}|^2$ for HNL masses between 5 GeV and 50 GeV.

title: Measurement of the $t\bar{t}H$ production cross section in the $H \to b\bar{b}$ decay channel in $pp$ collisions at $\sqrt{s}=13$ TeV
summary: A measurement of the associated production of a Higgs boson with a top quark-antiquark pair ($t\bar{t}H$) in proton-proton collisions at $\sqrt{s}=13$ TeV is presented. The analysis uses data corresponding to an integrated luminosity of $138\ \mathrm{fb}^{-1}$ recorded by the CMS experiment at the LHC. The $H \to b\bar{b}$ decay channel is explored using events with exactly one lepton and at least four jets.

title: Evidence for $B_s^0 \to D_s^{*+} D_s^{-}$ decays
summary: Evidence for the rare $B_s^0 \to D_s^{*+} D_s^{-}$ decay is reported using proton-proton collision data collected by the LHCb experiment at $\sqrt{s}=13$ TeV, corresponding to an integrated luminosity of $6\ \mathrm{fb}^{-1}$. The significance exceeds 4 standard deviations. The branching fraction is measured to be $\mathcal{B}(B_s^0 \to D_s^{*+} D_s^{-}) = (1.3 \pm 0.4) \times 10^{-3}$.

title: Dark photon search in $e^+e^- \to \gamma A'$ at Belle II
summary: A search for dark photons ($A'$) in the process $e^+e^- \to \gamma A'$ is performed using data collected by the Belle II experiment at SuperKEKB with an integrated luminosity of $424\ \mathrm{fb}^{-1}$. No significant signal is observed. Upper limits on the kinetic mixing parameter $\varepsilon^2$ are set for dark photon masses between 0.5 GeV and 10 GeV.

title: Precision measurement of the $W$ boson mass with the CDF II detector
summary: We present a precise measurement of the $W$ boson mass $m_W$ using data collected by the CDF II detector from $\sqrt{s}=1.96$ TeV proton-antiproton collisions at the Tevatron. The measurement uses $2.2\ \mathrm{fb}^{-1}$ of data and yields $m_W = 80433.5 \pm 6.4\ \mathrm{MeV}/c^2$, representing the most precise single experiment determination to date.

title: Search for lepton flavor violation in $\tau^- \to \mu^- \mu^+ \mu^-$ decays
summary: A search for the lepton-flavor-violating decay $\tau^- \to \mu^- \mu^+ \mu^-$ is performed using a data sample of $469\ \mathrm{fb}^{-1}$ recorded by the BaBar detector at the PEP-II $e^+e^-$ asymmetric-energy collider. No significant signal is observed and an upper limit on the branching fraction $\mathcal{B}(\tau^- \to \mu^- \mu^+ \mu^-) < 2.1 \times 10^{-8}$ at 90% confidence level is set.
